name: Imaxel editors for WooCommerce
author: imaxel

sections.description:
GROW YOUR PERSONALIZATION AND PHOTO PRODUCTS BUSINESS

The Imaxel editors plugin embeds the Imaxel personalisation W2P (web-to-print) workflow to enable the creation, sale and production of personalized products such as prints, photobooks, canvas, collages, gifts, t-shirts, mugs and others directly in your site using WooCommerce.

Cover all the needs of your photoproduct printing business with a single tool: expand your catalog, sell through the internet and omnichannel kiosk for stores accessible from a smartphone and automated print flows.

The online software for sale of custom printing on demand

Simplify the product customization process, manage the entire sales cycle, and automate the printing process through a single tool.

Imaxel offers the most complete solution on the market for the sale in store and online of photobooks, photography, personalized gifts, calendars, canvas and printed products.

Cover all the needs of your printing business with a single tool.

Visit us at www.imaxel.com

Before installing, you have to contract a subscription to the Imaxel platform. Contact Imaxel at www.imaxel.com to know more about the different editors for photobooks, gifts, etc. and their subscription prices.

After contracting the subscription, you will receive your unique API keys from Imaxel.

Input these in the plugin configuration screen and WooCommerce will launch the Imaxel online editor every time a customer wants to create and buy a personalized product such as a Photobook, canvas, etc.

FEATURES

  1. Creates new projects in the Imaxel editor
  2. Edits previous projects
  3. Duplicates projects
  4. Adds a list of projects to re-order or re-edit
  5. Integrates with WP accounts
  6. Links back to the WooCommerce shopping cart
  7. Receives automatic production orders after the order is paid
  8. Creates a section of Imaxel content that can be imported into WooCommerce
  9. Creates a list of projects for backoffice support and management

This plugin integrates with Imaxel services to enable product personalization workflows and production/order synchronization with your WooCommerce store.

Privacy

This plugin connects to Imaxel APIs to provide editor access, project handling, and order processing features.

External services

This plugin uses Imaxel services to let customers personalize products and to synchronize project/order information required to complete those workflows.

Service provider: Imaxel

Service endpoints:
– https://services.imaxel.com
– https://cdm.apps.imaxel.com
– https://customers-data-manager.integration.api.apps.imaxel.com
– https://creative-services.api.apps.imaxel.com

Data sent and when:
– On plugin activation/license validation, the plugin sends license credentials and domain-related information to validate and activate the service.
– When creating/editing/duplicating projects, the plugin sends project-related parameters required to open and manage the editor session.
– When processing production/order actions, the plugin sends order and project references, plus related order data needed for fulfillment workflows.

Legal links:
– Terms of Service: https://www.imaxel.com/en/legal-advice/
– Privacy Policy: https://www.imaxel.com/en/privacy-policy-2/

Source code and build process

The plugin source code is included in the distributed plugin package.

JavaScript files shipped in this plugin are maintained as part of the plugin codebase under:
– assets/js/
– assets/js/admin/

The release package is produced by our internal release process, which replaces version placeholders in plugin headers and readme with the released version number.

No additional closed-source or obfuscated build artifacts are required to run or maintain this plugin.
sections.installation:
1. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” menu in WordPress.

  2. Use the Licence Key provided by Imaxel in the service registration document.

  3. Import products from the Imaxel platform into WooCommerce, link them with your WooCommerce products and publish them to activate the integration with our editors.

You can contact and hire personalized support here.
sections.faq:
Does the plugin work stand alone or does it require a subscription?

This plugin is a connector to the Imaxel platform and requires an active subscription. Contact www.imaxel.com for details and prices.

What is the Imaxel platform?

The Imaxel platform is an online HTML5 editing platform that can be integrated into any ecommerce and is accessible from desktop, tablet or smartphone devices.

How do I sign up for an account with Imaxel?

The hiring process is managed through one of Imaxel’s technicians. Once the agreement is closed, you will be assigned a technician who will send you your access data and all the necessary information to start.

How long will it take to receive the credentials to access my account once I have registered?

You will receive the credentials for the different environments of the solution, ready to start selling, within 24 to 48 hours.

What kind of support will I get from Imaxel?

At the same time the account is contracted, and in the absence of an individually negotiated SLA, you will have the right to support via email with a guaranteed response within a maximum period of 24 hours. In addition, Imaxel also has packs of hours of technical support, implementation or design of templates that are charged as a separate service.

What type of service guarantee does the Imaxel solution offer?

All of our cloud software is hosted and served by one of the world’s leading hosting service providers, so the system uptime is 99.95%.

To what extent can I request modifications or adaptations of the software?

If there is any functionality that you need that is not included in the software, you can always request it from the Imaxel team to evaluate it and, if so, we will prepare a budget for the implementation cost.

How can I see a working environment?

Get in touch with us, and we’ll provide you access to a demo, so you can check if our software really suits your needs.

Can I buy the Imaxel solution if I don’t have a website?

Yes. With our standard solution, we provide you with a WebApp already configured and ready to use. In this way, your clients will be able to use it on the internet and on their mobile. And if what you want is to expand your sales through a well-positioned website, we also offer you the possibility of developing an e-commerce portal for photo products and positioning it in the main search engines.

Can I use the Imaxel ordering and personalization platform as a kiosk in my store?

Of course! All you need is a computer with a touch screen or an “all-in-one” computer with an internet connection where you will install our kiosk software and connect it to your Imaxel account.

Can I create an account with Imaxel to start a business of selling photo products and gifts or personalization products if I don’t have printing equipment?

Yes. You put the creativity and the ideas, and Imaxel will do the rest. We have a network of printers around the world to be able to serve those who do not have equipment to print.

Can I integrate the Imaxel solution with the website that I already have?

Yes. You do not have to give up the use of your website or e-commerce if you already have one. We have extensions for the main platforms on the market and a REST API for systems made with our own code.
sections.changelog:
1.3.74

  • Renamed internal functions, classes, constants, options, shortcode, AJAX actions, nonces and script handles from the generic wc_/WC_Imaxel_ prefixes to the dedicated imaxel_/Imaxel_ prefixes to avoid collisions with WooCommerce and other plugins.
  • Existing plugin settings are migrated automatically to the new option keys on update; no manual reconfiguration is required.
  • Renamed the customizable cross-selling shortcode from [wc_imaxel_cross_selling] to [imaxel_cross_selling].
  • Renamed the admin menu/page slugs and the wc_imaxel_setting_fields filter hook to the imaxel prefix.
  • Security: every AJAX and front-end action handler now verifies its nonce explicitly before reading any request input, in addition to capability/ownership checks.
  • Customers can now set a custom title for their projects from the My Account area.

1.3.68

  • Security hardening: nonce verification and capability checks in admin and frontend flows, including AJAX handlers and admin list-table actions.
  • Sanitization of request inputs and late output escaping in shortcode and cart rendering.
  • Readme: clarified description, fixed support link, added explicit External services section and Source code notes.
  • Compatibility: updated WordPress headers and added Requires Plugins for WooCommerce.

1.1.12

  • Added disclosure about Imaxel API usage and included terms and privacy policy links in the plugin readme file.

1.1.0

  • Add translations to the plugin.
  • Links the plugin manual to a URL of our help center on the imaxel.com website.
  • Sends new pickpoint information to print in the Imaxel production sheet if the WooCommerce Pickup Plus plugin is in use.
  • It is now possible to process orders with lines from different Imaxel WordPress plugins.

1.0.28

  • Updated the WordPress readme.txt file to improve the description of the plugin.

1.0.0

  • First release.
  • Plugin works with both WooCommerce storage methods: with High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS) enabled or disabled.
  • Makes the plugin compatible with the old Imaxel WordPress plugin.
  • Increases timeout request due to large times in new project creation.

upgrade_notice.1.3.74: • Internal naming was moved to a dedicated imaxel_ prefix for WordPress.org compliance. Existing settings migrate automatically. After updating, purge any page/CDN and object cache so the refreshed scripts are served. The admin menu URLs changed (now admin.php?page=imaxel), so any saved bookmarks to the old wc-imaxel admin pages need to be updated. If you placed the cross-selling block manually, update the shortcode to [imaxel_cross_selling].
upgrade_notice.1.3.68: • Recommended security and compliance update. Updates admin and frontend authorization checks and clarifies the readme documentation.
upgrade_notice.1.1.12: • Added disclosure about Imaxel API usage and included terms and privacy policy links in the plugin readme file.
upgrade_notice.1.1.0:
• An update is needed if a language other than Spanish is required.
  • Also this version solves some issues if you are coming from a migration from the old Imaxel plugin, such as fixing the production sheet if you use the WooCommerce Pickup Plus plugin, or being able to process orders with items from both our old and new plugin, in case you have both plugins activated due to slower migration.
